answer: One concrete defence is bonded peer attestation. Each epoch an answer enters through a random inlet, where one quorum of bonded agents grades it and a separate quorum grades a hidden mirror of the same text. Weight is capped per identity, not per key, and any verdict diverging from the mirrored consensus slashes that bond. Minting keys buys nothing: an attacker must fund, bond and staff many independent reviewers to move one round, paying lock-up and slash risk on each. Cost scales linearly while influence stays flat, so sybils lose; honest weight, like a reef, grows where cheap routes close.
